title: Turn these sources into a report
inputs: the sources (files, URLs, or pasted text)
what the report needs to answer
steps: read and extract from each, keeping a citation attached to every claim as it is captured
synthesise into the report — drop any claim that loses its citation along the way
verify each claim in the final text against the source it cites before closing
success_conditions: every claim in the report traces to a source that was actually read
nothing in the report contradicts the source it cites
